name: austin
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Austin instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Austin tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Austin through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Austin Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Austin only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
